mission_phase: Generation 24 - Sector-level view with cross-site comparison
phase_goal: Give each sector its own view: the sector's shared query packs, its member sites, and a cross-site comparison table (latest-run status, readiness, coverage, warnings, failures per member site) so the operator can see how the sites in a sector stack up. Reachable from the Shared view and from a site's sector membership, with a Shared > Sector breadcrumb and each member row linking back to its site.
reason_generation_started: Operator: build the sector-level view with cross-site comparison. Closes the GEN-023 known gap that sectors had no dedicated view (members + shared packs + cross-site comparison); sectors were only surfaced from a site and from Shared.
standing_directive: OPERATOR DIRECTIVE (2026-07-15): do NOT trigger inspection runs and do NOT apply destructive cleanup. Build and validate the comparison against runs already on disk; the comparison must be honest about members with no run yet. Recorded as FND-GEN021-000.

functional: A sector view shows the sector name/description, its shared query pack(s), and a cross-site comparison table with one row per member site.
Each member row shows that site's latest-run status, readiness, coverage, warning and failure counts — or 'not yet inspected' when the site has no run.
The sector view is reachable by clicking a sector in the Shared view and from a site's sector membership; a Shared > Sector breadcrumb is shown and each member row links to that site.
The comparison reflects only the sector's member sites and is derived from runs already on disk (no run triggered).
usability: Interactive holistic walkthrough (as-a-user, no runs triggered): Shared -> click a sector -> see members + comparison -> click a member -> land on that site; navigate back; all views coherent.
Confirm no inspection is triggered by any navigation.
technical: validate:dashboard asserts the sector API returns the sector's members with per-site comparison metrics and shared query packs, and that a membered sector's comparison includes its member site; validate:gen13 and validate stay green; git diff --check clean; no run-inspection process spawned.

validation_notes: VAL-072 two clean passes: validate:dashboard (asserts sector API + comparison), validate:gen13, validate all green; pass 2 after commit with no implementation changes.
Holistic UI walkthrough live: Shared → sector comparison → member site → back; honest "not yet inspected" for un-run members; no inspection triggered.
Pink Lily added to Women's Apparel so the comparison is a real multi-site one (Dress Up un-inspected, Pink Lily with a run).
BDD inventory refreshed to BDD-INV-013 (66 BDDs, 3 new for GEN-024, 64 passing, 2 deferred).
known_gaps_opened: The comparison is at latest-run health level (status/readiness/coverage/warnings/failures); it does not yet compare per-query or per-surface results across the sector's shared query pack.
Sites are not yet grouped by sector in the left sidebar; sectors are reached from Shared and from a site.
